purpose: Evaluate graph-native closed-loop racing, traffic response, surface adaptation, recovery, and compound actuator-damage resilience in a coupled full-race plant.

guardrails.agent_logic: Rust graph rules and authored graph state only
guardrails.host_role: Simulator integration, exact transduction, termination, and reporting only

features: load-sensitive tyre saturation and friction ellipse
pit entry, timed service, refuelling, tyres, and repair
independent drive and brake commands at all four wheels

external_validation.boundary: Policy-free C++ UDP telemetry and actuator robot module

limitations: The deterministic plant is not CFD or a suspension multibody solver.
Scripted opponents are environmental actors rather than other learning agents.
Contact avoidance remains an explicit improvement target because the v1 run reaches the collision ceiling.
The recorded Speed Dreams run is a short integration smoke, not a lap-time or racecraft benchmark.
